rows.label: Vox Solaris quest and The War Within
talk to Onkko in Cetus once
rows.note: then Little Duck in Fortuna, as your Operator or Drifter

conditions: Little Duck only talks to your Operator or Drifter, not your Warframe.

groups.sub: Spaceport, Enrichment Labs, Temple of Profit
groups.activity: farm Toroids and turn them in to Little Duck
conditions: Vega, Calda and Sola Toroids are 1,000 standing each; Narmer Isoplast 2,000, Crisma Toroid 6,000, Lazulite Toroid 12,000.
Vox Solaris standing counts against the daily syndicate cap.
Little Duck sells Gyromag Systems at Rank 1 (1,000 standing) and Atmo Systems at Rank 2 (2,500), so the climb never needs Profit-Taker.
Spawns stall at the Toroid areas; if kills dry up, reset the area or move to another.
bonuses: Destroy reinforcement beacons to reset enemy levels without leaving; a loot frame, resource drop booster and Steel Path all help. One player got about 12 Sola Toroids in 30 minutes at Temple of Profit on Steel Path.
Narmer bounties pay 2,000-standing Isoplasts and are a steadier option for some players.
Pick up Hildryn's blueprint (Rank 2) and Amp parts on the way; it's the same standing.

disclosures.title: Exploiter Orb, the fastest standing
disclosures.body: Each kill drops a Lazulite Toroid worth 12,000, covering both Repellers in one. It needs 1 Diluted Thermia and starts at Deck 12, even outside the Fractures event, but starting it yourself needs Solaris United Rank 5 (Old Mate). Below that, join a squad whose host starts it. It also drops Hildryn parts.

rows.label: Repeller Systems
rows.alt: 3 per Profit-Taker heist phase, 7.5-8.6%, needs Solaris United Old Mate

conditions: Repeller Systems don't need Old Mate or the heists; Rank 3 needs no Solaris United standing.
Argon decays each daily reset, so farm it right before you build.
